Name: Auto Screenshot
Author: Pathstar
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Auto Scrennshot & Location Photography[/b][/size]

[i]A configurable screenshot system for Stardew Valley that automatically records the places that matter to you.[/i][/center]

[b]About This Mod[/b]

This mod automatically takes screenshots of your farm — but it is not limited to the farm.

You can use it to automatically document [b]any location you want to keep track of[/b], whether that is the Farm, Ginger Island, a custom modded location, or another area added by your mods.

Unlike many automatic screenshot mods that just take a screenshot when you go out in the morning, this mod can react to [b]changes in the location itself[/b]. You can configure it to take a screenshot after a certain number of qualifying location changes, allowing you to capture the evolution of a farm or other area over time without filling your screenshot folder with unnecessary images.

[b]If you want a convenient way to view the summarized configuration introduction, you can check the file [/b]
[code]config_annotation.json[/code]
[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Automatic Location Recording[/b] — Automatically capture screenshots when entering specified locations.[/*]
[*][b]Location Change Detection[/b] — Take a screenshot when the selected location has changed a configurable number of times.[/*]
[*][b]Works With Any Location[/b] — Not limited to the Farm. Use it with custom and modded locations as well.[/*]
[*][b]Per-Location Rules[/b] — Configure location-based triggers independently.[/*]
[*][b]Trigger Counters[/b] — Take a photo only after a specified number of qualifying triggers.[/*]
[*][b]Time Restrictions[/b] — Restrict screenshots to specific in-game time ranges.[/*]
[*][b]Daily Photo Limits[/b] — Prevent excessive screenshots on a given in-game day.[/*]
[*][b]Global Photo Cooldown[/b] — Prevent screenshots from being taken too frequently.[/*]
[*][b]Custom Screenshot Filenames[/b] — Include real-world time, in-game date, location, trigger type, save name, player name, and more.[/*]
[*][b]UTC or Local Time[/b] — Choose which clock is used in generated filenames.[/*]
[*][b]Location Name Helper[/b] — Print the current location name when entering it, making configuration easier.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Trigger Types[/b]

[heading]1. Location Entry[/heading]

Triggered when you enter one of the configured locations from another location.

This is useful for periodic snapshots of a farm or other important areas.

[b]Example:[/b]

Set the trigger to:

[code]Locations: Farm, IslandWest
Triggers before taking photo: 1
Daily photo limit: 1[/code]
The mod can then take a screenshot the first time you enter the Farm or Ginger Island each game day.

The trigger also supports:
[list]
[*]Trigger cooldown[/*]
[*]Allowed in-game time ranges[/*]
[*]Number of qualifying triggers required before taking a photo[/*]
[*]Maximum photos per in-game day[/*]
[/list]
[heading]2. Location Change[/heading]

Triggered when the selected location changes, such as changes to objects, terrain, or other detectable modifications within the location.

This is the main feature that distinguishes the mod from simple automatic screenshot tools.

Instead of taking a screenshot every few seconds, you can configure the mod to wait until the location has changed a certain number of times.

[b]Example:[/b]

[code]Locations: Farm
Triggers before taking photo: 16[/code]
After 16 qualifying changes to the Farm, the mod takes a screenshot.

This makes it possible to create a visual record of how your farm develops without generating a huge number of nearly identical images.

[b][color=#ff9900]Performance Note:[/color][/b]

Location-change screenshots may cause approximately [b]0.5 seconds of lag[/b] when the screenshot is actually taken. This is usually difficult to notice during a location warp, but it may be noticeable during normal gameplay.

[b]Configuration[/b]

All settings can be configured through the mod's configuration file.

[heading]General Settings[/heading]

[b]Enabled[/b]
Turns the entire screenshot system on or off.

[b]Photo Cooldown[/b]
Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between actual screenshots.

This cooldown is shared by all trigger types and locations.

[b]Screenshot Name Template[/b]
Allows you to completely customize the generated screenshot filename.

Supported parameters include:

[code]{gameSaveName}
{playerName}

{year}
{month}
{day}
{hour}
{minute}
{second}
{millisecond}
{totalMilliseconds}

{gameYear}
{gameSeason}
{gameDay}
{gameTime}

{location}
{triggerBy}[/code]
For example:

[code]MyWorld_2026-08-20-16-22-58-742_2-summer-18-1230_Farm_LocationEntry[/code]
[b]Use UTC Time[/b]
Choose whether the real-world timestamp in the filename uses UTC or local time.

[b]Print Location Name When Entering[/b]
Useful when configuring unfamiliar or modded locations.

When enabled, the mod prints the location name when you enter it, allowing you to identify the exact name that should be used in the configuration.

[heading]Location Entry Trigger Settings[/heading]

[b]Locations[/b]
A comma-separated list of locations to monitor.

[b]Trigger Cooldown[/b]
Minimum time, in seconds, between qualifying trigger events.

[b]Allowed Time Ranges[/b]
Restrict the trigger to specific in-game times.

Example:

[code]06:00-22:00[/code]
Multiple time ranges can be specified by separating them with commas.

[b]Triggers Before Taking Photo[/b]
Defines how many qualifying triggers must occur before a screenshot is taken.

[b]Daily Photo Limit[/b]
Maximum number of screenshots this trigger may create per in-game day.

[b]0 = unlimited[/b]

[heading]Location Change Trigger Settings[/heading]

[b]Locations[/b]
A comma-separated list of locations to monitor.

[b]Trigger Cooldown[/b]
Minimum time, in seconds, between qualifying location changes.

[b]Allowed Time Ranges[/b]
Restrict change detection to specific in-game time ranges.

[b]Triggers Before Taking Photo[/b]
Number of qualifying location changes required before taking a screenshot.

For example,
[code]16[/code]means one screenshot is taken after 16 qualifying changes.

[b]Daily Photo Limit[/b]
Maximum number of screenshots this trigger may create per in-game day.

[b]0 = unlimited[/b]

[b]Restrictions & Defaults[/b]

[b]Empty string or 0[/b] generally means [b]unlimited / no restriction[/b] for settings where that convention applies.

The configuration is evaluated [b]independently for each configured location[/b]. This allows different locations to have their own trigger counters, cooldowns, time restrictions, and daily limits.

The [b]global photo cooldown[/b] still applies to actual screenshots regardless of which trigger caused them.

[b]Example Configuration[/b]

A simple setup for automatically documenting a farm once per day:

[code]"locationEntryTrigger": {
"enabled": true,
"locations": "Farm, IslandWest",
"triggerCooldown": 60,
"allowedTimeRanges": "",
"triggersBeforeTakingPhoto": 1,
"dailyPhotoLimit": 1
}

"changeTrigger": {
"enabled": true,
"locations": "Farm, IslandWest",
"triggerCooldown": 1,
"allowedTimeRanges": "",
"triggersBeforeTakingPhoto": 16,
"dailyPhotoLimit": 0
}[/code]

[b]In Short[/b]

This mod is designed to be a [b]location history and automatic photography system[/b] rather than simply an automatic screenshot timer.

You decide [b]where[/b] to take photos, [b]when[/b] they are allowed, [b]how many events must occur first[/b], and [b]how frequently[/b] screenshots can actually be created.

Whether you want one picture of your farm every day or a visual archive that follows the evolution of a location as you build and modify it, the configuration is designed to give you control over how that record is created.
